name: FeatureGrid
description: Grid of feature or benefit cards with an icon, title, copy and optional link.
designIntent: Marketing pages repeat three- and six-card feature groups. FeatureGrid standardizes the card hierarchy, icon tile, grid and link affordance without forcing a separate Card composition on every page.

props.name: features
props.description: Features to display: title, optional description, icon, href and actionLabel.

props.name: variant
props.description: Card surface or a plain stack.

examples.title: Three benefits
examples.code:
<FeatureGrid
  features={[
    { title: 'Vetted advisors', description: 'Curated for your business', icon: <Shield /> },
    { title: 'Buyer targeting', description: 'Reach the right investors', href: '/features/buyers', actionLabel: 'Learn more' },
  ]}
/>
examples.description: A two-column feature group with one linked card.

antiPatterns.title: Don't put a button inside a linked card
antiPatterns.explanation: The whole card is a link when href is present. A nested button creates invalid interaction and conflicting targets.

accessibility.implementation: Renders ul/li so the group and item count are announced
The card is a single link; the action label is part of its accessible name
accessibility.userRequirements: Use a short action label and avoid duplicate links to the same destination

compositionRules.relationship: Place FeatureGrid inside a Section band
